wiki.title: Dean Kaufert
wiki.extract: Dean R. Kaufert (born May 23, 1957) is an American business owner and Republican politician from Neenah, Wisconsin. He is a member of the Wisconsin State Assembly, representing Wisconsin's 53rd Assembly district since 2025. He previously represented the 55th Assembly district from 1991 to 2015, and served as mayor of Neenah from 2014 to 2022.
